build: The unmodified pinned CPU was compiled by the repository conformance recipe with GGML_CPU_GENERIC, -ffp-contract=off and one worker.
reference: Decode the same frozen 29 GGML arrays as VT-180 with original type traits, reverse the two right rows and run the original CPU F32 ADD once per input pair. For I8, I16 and I32 use original ggml_get_i32_1d followed by ggml_set_i32_1d. For I64 and F64 use pinned Berkeley SoftFloat f32_to_i64_r_minMag and f32_to_f64 on the original sum.
